subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
summary: A leaf forces internal coverage of an attachment point. Joining only these supports preserves domination polynomials, giving connected minus-four families and every order at least 35.
summary_zh: 叶子迫使连接点在原图内部被覆盖。只连接这样的支撑点就保留支配多项式，得到根为负四的连通无限族和每个至少三十五的阶。
title: A leaf preserves a root
